name: Threads
description: Threads is Meta's text-based social network for public conversations, creator updates, and community participation. People and organizations use it to publish short posts, follow ongoing discussions, and maintain a public social presence.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Threads profile through Relay-owned OAuth, then let agents read bounded own-profile activity, draft plain-text posts, and publish one exact approved update without exposing tokens or broad Graph access.

capabilities.label: Read profile
capabilities.description: Read the exact connected Threads profile.

capabilities.label: Read own posts
capabilities.description: List at most ten recent own posts and inspect one exact owned post.

capabilities.label: Draft text posts
capabilities.description: Draft one plain-text post locally without a provider request.

capabilities.label: Publish text posts
capabilities.description: Publish one approval-controlled plain-text post of at most 500 characters.

allowed.label: Read connected profile
allowed.description: Read the exact OAuth-bound Threads profile.

allowed.label: List own posts
allowed.description: List at most ten recent posts owned by the connected profile.

allowed.label: Read own post
allowed.description: Read one explicit post only after verifying it belongs to the connected profile.

allowed.label: Draft text post
allowed.description: Prepare one plain-text post locally without contacting Threads.

approvalRequired.label: Publish text post
approvalRequired.description: Publish one exact approval-controlled plain-text post.

blocked.label: Block broader social actions
blocked.description: Replies, discovery, insights, media, links, polls, tags, locations, quotes, reposts, deletion, bulk actions and arbitrary Graph access are not registered.

blocked.label: Block secret exposure
blocked.description: App secrets and user access tokens never leave Railway or appear in agent results.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Profile reads, own-post reads and local drafts run; publishing requires exact-payload approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All five selected Threads actions run without Relay per-action approval; exact profile ownership, provider authority, bounds, audits and secret isolation still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts five typed Threads wrappers and attaches the encrypted user token only at Railway's fixed Threads Graph adapter.
Relay mounts five typed Threads wrappers and attaches the encrypted user token only at Railway's fixed Threads Graph adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: A business-verified Meta app with the Threads use case, exact permissions, production review/distribution, Railway credentials and live consent acceptance remains for the separate provider-console task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, configure the exact Railway HTTPS callback and public legal URLs, request threads_basic and threads_content_publish, store staging credentials, then validate consent, exact profile binding, long-lived exchange/refresh, bounded reads, exact approved publish, ambiguity handling, disconnect and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Meta documents the Threads authorization flow, Threads user access token lifecycle and the permissions used by the bounded Relay surface.
Meta documents creating a Threads media container and publishing it through the Threads Graph endpoints.
Meta documents profile and Threads media retrieval fields used by Relay's own-profile and own-post reads.
